Method of Attack: Providing a 'no distribute scanner' service that allows malware authors to scan their malware to check if it is detected by antivirus software without sharing results with antivirus vendors
Offering an API embedded in malware products (e.g., RATs, keyloggers) to check payload detectability
Enabling malware authors to ensure malware is undetectable before distribution
Impacted Systems: Systems infected by remote access trojans (RATs)
Over 16,000 infected computers by a keylogger sold to over 3,000 customers
Attack Vector: Use of a web portal hosted on Amazon Web Services servers
Malware authors embedding scanner API in malware toolkits
Payments processed via PayPal account for full access
Indicators of Compromise: Use of the scanner API in malware samples analyzed by MalwareHunter
Scanner service advertised on hacking forums and Dark Web
Payments via PayPal account in Martisevs' name
